name: hs-femtech-mcp
description: Neutral verification registry for femtech (women's health) information sources. Indexes sources by provenance, authority tier, jurisdiction, and machine-readable compensation disclosure, with a re-computable SHA-256. No diagnosis, no efficacy claims, no product endorsement, no referral fees. MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0) + A2A agent card.
author: The HORIZ音s株式会社 (HORIZON SHIELD)
